text:
Devon C.: quick heads-up — ran a linkscan on the runtime guide and found a handful of 404s in the model-onboarding section. not urgent but wanted to flag before next release.
Eva M.: thanks! any chance you can paste the grep/scan output? saves me a roundtrip. :pray:
Devon C.: sure — output snippet below:
```
grep -R "model-onboarding" docs/runtime | xargs -n1 curl -s -I | grep 404
# results: /runtime/model-onboarding/s3-setup -> 404
# /runtime/model-onboarding/auth -> 404
```
Sarah L.: +1 saw the s3-setup one earlier this morning in staging. I opened a tiny PR for rehosted image + redirect (GH #2145). pinging owners for the auth doc.
Miguel R.: @Sarah L. can you drop the PR link? I think the auth page was moved during the last restructure.
Sarah L.: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2145 — fixes the s3 image path and adds a 301 redirect. tests passing locally. :white_check_mark:
Devon C.: thanks — the auth page looks like it got a new slug. original path: /runtime/model-onboarding/auth, new path: /runtime/security/authentication. might be a canonical mismatch.
Alex P.: putting myself down to own the auth redirect if no one else claims it. can add a frontmatter redirect.
Ben K.: if we add a redirect, please also update any internal links; search replaced a few but not all. I can run a site-wide replace in the PR branch.
docs-bot: Reminder — docs link-scan ran at 2024-06-12T15:03:20Z. Found 3 unique 404s.
Eva M.: quick ask — can we also add the new slug to the runtime TOC? it's missing and caused some navigation confusion during the QA pass.
Alex P.: will do. planning a small PR to add redirect + TOC entry + update a couple internal links. aiming to have it up by EOD.
Miguel R.: tiny code-review request — can someone glance at the redirect frontmatter? example we want is:
```
---
redirect_from: 
  - /runtime/model-onboarding/auth
---
```
Devon C.: looks good. @Ben K. are you fine if Alex pushes the branch and you run the sitewide replace in the PR?
Ben K.: yep, fine. will do the replace and leave comments for anything that looks risky.
Sarah L.: once Alex opens the PR, I'll attach it to the sprint card and mark it as docs-hotfix.
Alex P.: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2199 — contains redirect frontmatter, TOC update, and a few link fixes. please review when you can.
Miguel R.: reviewing now, will leave minor nits. :eyes:
Eva M.: thanks team. if anyone sees other small 404s while running quick checks, drop them here and we'll queue them for a docs sweep.
Devon C.: appreciate the quick triage. tagging @docs-team for visibility. :thumbsup:
